ruleDefinitions.name: File Download From Browser Process Via Inline URL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of a browser process with a URL argument pointing to a file with a potentially interesting extension. This can be abused to download arbitrary files or to hide from the user for example by launching the browser in a minimized state.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.7z$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.txt$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.zip$")))
